description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Trundle''' erects a pillar of ice at the target location for 6 seconds, which [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocks back]] units hit up to 225 units from its center. The pillar acts as [[terrain]] and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] nearby enemies.
description.text: Active: Trundle erects a pillar of ice at the target location for 6 seconds, which knocks back units hit up to 225 units from its center. The pillar acts as terrain and slows nearby enemies.

notes.raw: * ''Pillar of Ice'' displaces allied units away from the area but does not render them [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|airborne]]. ** Allied [[File:Channeling icon.svg|20px|link=Channel|An icon representing the keyword Channel]] [[:Channel|channels]] (e.g. [[File:Recall.png|20xpx|border|link=Recall|An icon representing Recall]] [[Recall]], [[File:Teleport.png|20xpx|border|link=Teleport|An icon representing Teleport]] [[Teleport]]) will be [[File:Silence icon.png|20px|link=Crowd control#Disruption|An icon representing the keyword Interrupt]] [[:Crowd control#Disruption|interrupted]] however. * ''Pillar of Ice'' cannot be placed inside impassable terrain. Attempting to do so will cause the pillar to spawn in the nearest available spot of accessible terrain. * ''Pillar Of Ice'' triggers effects such as drawing turret aggro, [[File:Sudden Impact rune.png|20xpx|link=Sudden Impact|An icon representing Sudden Impact]] [[Sudden Impact]] and applying [[File:Elixir of Sorcery item.png|20xpx|border|link=Elixir of Sorcery|An icon for the item Elixir of Sorcery]] [[Elixir of Sorcery]] by dealing 0 [[File:Wit's End item.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Proc damage]] [[:Damage|proc]] [[File:Hybrid penetration.png|20px|link=True damage|An icon representing the keyword True damage]] [[:True damage|true damage]].
notes.text:
Pillar of Ice displaces allied units away from the area but does not render them airborne.
* Allied channels (e.g. Recall, Teleport) will be interrupted however.
Pillar of Ice cannot be placed inside impassable terrain. Attempting to do so will cause the pillar to spawn in the nearest available spot of accessible terrain.
Pillar Of Ice triggers effects such as drawing turret aggro, Sudden Impact and applying Elixir of Sorcery by dealing 0 proc true damage.
